limitations: Hashes record repository bytes inspected during packaging; hosted code is not included or executed.
Installed validation checks local client bytes and this retained review declaration.
Hosted deployment, live controls and model delivery require separate acceptance evidence.

external_boundaries.content: Fixed public GET paths identifying prepared assets by SHA-256 and original filename, plus ordinary connection metadata. No client files, local paths, teaching profile, answers, progress or feedback are sent.
controls: HTTPS and mparanza.com only, including redirects; no credentials or query parameters; passive lesson-data extensions only; 30-second request timeout and 25 MB cap; SHA-256 checked before atomic write; only selected-language attachments are fetched; no code is downloaded or executed.
external_boundaries.retention: Verified prepared files stay in the selected local lesson folder. Hosted access-log retention and other provider copies are outside this helper; no deletion schedule is enforced by the download.

security_controls.control: HTTPS and mparanza.com only, including redirects; no credentials or query parameters; passive lesson-data extensions only; 30-second request timeout and 25 MB cap; SHA-256 checked before atomic write; only selected-language attachments are fetched; no code is downloaded or executed.
security_controls.on_violation: Reject unapproved origins, oversized or non-passive content and mismatching SHA-256 before atomic write.

access.arrangement: Public unauthenticated HTTPS files under https://mparanza.com/static/shared/courses/lucia/; host network permissions remain enforced.
